content: In parallel with the expanding market size, the operational cost environment and pricing structures within the bulk freight sector have experienced significant volatility and upward pressure. Recent analyses of freight rates reveal a marked escalation in the costs associated with bulk transport logistics. According to industry observations from May 2026, bulk freight rates have surged considerably, with the median per-mile rate reaching 5.03. This elevated pricing structure reflects a 7.7 percent month-over-month increase from April 2026 and a highly notable 23.0 percent rise compared to the prior year [1] . This sharp increase in per-mile rates underscores a tightening of capacity, potential inflationary pressures on operational inputs, and robust underlying demand for bulk transport services. However, it is critical to recognize that this insight focuses predominantly on pricing trends rather than the distribution of market share among the leading freight companies [1] . The broader logistics and shipping context further illustrates the operational complexities facing bulk and general cargo carriers. The lack of precise historical metrics for these leading entities implies that strategic planning for firms like CG Transport and CG Auto Transport must rely heavily on current pricing signals and future market size projections rather than historical precedent. The confirmed 23.0 percent year-over-year increase in median per-mile rates indicates that pricing power currently resides with operators capable of securing reliable capacity and optimizing their routing networks [1] . For CG Transport and CG Auto Transport, the strategic imperative involves leveraging the projected market growth to 174 billion in 2026 as a foundation for scaling operations, while simultaneously implementing rigorous cost-control measures to navigate the volatile spot rate environment [3] . The most recent and relevant industry assessments, particularly those from June 2026, identify Montway Auto Transport, Sherpa Auto Transport, and SGT Auto Transport as the foremost competitors in the domestic car shipping industry, driven by their strategic emphasis on secure and cost-effective transport solutions [54] . This contemporary snapshot aligns with the ongoing operational shifts within the sector, where fleet reliability and customer-centric service models are paramount.
